reported.title: RPM line format wrong: lowercase and space after colon
reported.description: printRpm() at lines 45-46 emits "rpm: " (lowercase, with a trailing space) followed by the value, so no line ever matches the required /^RPM:[0-9]+$/. Measured evidence: "No serial line matched /^RPM:[0-9]+$/ in 8.00 s; expected one every 1000 ms" across all scenarios. No serial line matched /^RPM:[0-9]+$/ in 8.00 s; expected one every 1000 ms.

reported.title: Printed rpm unparsable due to wrong prefix
reported.description: The value is printed only via printRpm() at lines 45-46 using the "rpm: " prefix, so the harness regex /RPM:(-?[0-9.]+)/ never matches and the printed value cannot be compared with A5. Measured evidence: "No serial line matched /RPM:(-?[0-9.]+)/ so the printed value could not be compared with A5." No serial line matched /RPM:(-?[0-9.]+)/ so the printed value could not be compared with A5.

reported.title: Over-speed lamp state wrong around threshold and mute transitions
reported.description: updateWarn() at lines 38-40 is only called from the 50 ms sampling block (lines 63-69), so D9 lags the A5 threshold crossing and mute changes by up to a sample period, and the lamp is driven from the last sampled rpm rather than the current input. Measured evidence: "D9 was not HIGH for 1359 ms while required (grace 500 ms)" starting at 2.10 s, and "D9 was not HIGH for 1501 ms while required" at 5.00 s. D9 was in the wrong state for 1359 ms across 1 interval(s), first at 2.10 s: D9 was not HIGH for 1359 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

judge_input.spec:
- Tach input on A5 at 1 mV per rpm; over-speed lamp on D9; mute on D3 (pull-up).
- Print `RPM:<n>` with no space after the colon once per second (1000 ms ±120 ms).
- Printed rpm must stay within ±50 of the injected tach value.
- Light D9 when rpm is at or above 2000 while mute is released.
- While D3 is held LOW, keep D9 OFF regardless of rpm.
- Each second also print `spindle min=<n> max=<n>` after the RPM line.
